# Submission

## Summary
One hand-in version for one enrolment × assignment: text, files, Submission Status, grade link; `isLate`/`daysLate` derived from the due moment.

## Usage
Created by Submit Assignment; graded by Grade Submission.

## Non-goals
Penalty applied lives on Grade.

## Example
The linked submission is a first version of the metric tree assignment.
